author_red.test_source_limit: Saved pre-extension source is reconstructed; no claim that a whole earlier runtime test-file hash was captured.

tested: Full 64-bit volume/128-bit file identity plus observed size/hash; identical-byte foreign and different-byte files do not match.
Borrowed handle is never read, sought or closed; caller cursor and ownership survive normal and failing comparisons.
Invalid, pipe, character, directory, reparse, metadata-only, empty and oversize handles refuse before bytes; asynchronous readable handle uses a private synchronous ReOpenFile reader.
Actual observed metadata drift and injected query/reopen/seek/read/post-read failures cannot return an attestation.
Private-reader close failure retains ownership on the invalidated guard for retry; original 17 constructor/snapshot/cleanup assertions remain unchanged.
limits: Standalone component outside PROFILE_SOURCES; no actual guardian/worker runtime consumer or native launch qualification.
Synchronous disk IO is bounded by bytes, not a wall-clock deadline; caller must keep the borrowed handle live and serialize its use.
Fresh metadata detects observed drift; it does not exclude every metadata mutation or ABA.
Historical V6 remains frozen at ffcd1b44 and old image source ab6c6aca; it does not qualify this changed API.
No SDK/native20/V6/where/model calls; unchanged legacy junction fixtures use only their own cmd/mklink setup.
No reasoning/input-use gate, all18 eligibility, business benefit or live rollout established.
